SELECT
    p.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName,
    sum(i.OnHandQuantity) AS current_on_hand_inventory,
    sum(i.SafetyStockQuantity) AS current_safety_stock_level,
    sum(i.OnHandQuantity) - sum(i.SafetyStockQuantity) AS inventory_gap
FROM retail.FactInventory AS i
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON i.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE i.DateKey = (
    SELECT max(DateKey)
    FROM retail.FactInventory
)
GROUP BY
    p.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName
ORDER BY inventory_gap DESC
LIMIT 10
